$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. Every icon renamed after it shipped: the old name, the new one, and the version the new name ships in. A rename from 1.0.0 on is also an alias, because a 1.x name is a promise to everyone who imported it: pipeline/build-react.mjs keeps the old export as a deprecated alias of the new component. Earlier renames were breaking changes by the rules of 0.x and stay that way. The aliases go at the next major. An old name drawn again as a new icon is `reclaimed` in the version that draws it (`flower`, in 2.8.0): from then on it is that drawing and keeps no alias. The old name also belongs under the new one in the `names` map of data/icon-aliases.json.
